name: sadamata-workspace
description: Root runner for the 4 Sadamata Next.js apps. Not a monorepo - each app keeps its own package.json and node_modules.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,merchant,brand,dashboard -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:merchant" "npm run dev:brand" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.build: concurrently -n frontend,merchant,brand,dashboard -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm run build --prefix frontend" "npm run build --prefix merchant" "npm run build --prefix brand" "npm run build --prefix dashboard"
scripts.build:seq: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix merchant && npm run build --prefix brand && npm run build --prefix dashboard
scripts.start: concurrently -n frontend,merchant,brand,dashboard -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green "npm run start --prefix frontend -- --port 3000" "npm run start --prefix merchant -- --port 3001" "npm run start --prefix brand -- --port 3002" "npm run start --prefix dashboard -- --port 3003"
scripts.install:all: concurrently -n frontend,merchant,brand,dashboard -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm install --prefix frontend" "npm install --prefix merchant" "npm install --prefix brand" "npm install --prefix dashboard"
scripts.generate: concurrently -n frontend,merchant,brand,dashboard -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green "npx prisma generate --schema frontend/prisma/schema.prisma" "npx prisma generate --schema merchant/prisma/schema.prisma" "npx prisma generate --schema brand/prisma/schema.prisma" "npx prisma generate --schema dashboard/prisma/schema.prisma"
